# What Does this Mod do?
This mod allows you to customise the effect trees have on Noise Pollution. While this is already a base game feature, the vanilla system uses a fairly weak logarithmic calculation. This mod replaces that with a **fully customisable system** through the Mod Menu.
# How the Math Works
The mod processes noise reduction using two distinct mathematical models that you can swap between in the settings:
## 1. Linear Mode (Default)
This mode treats every tree as an equal contributor to noise reduction. It is best for players who want a significant, noticeable impact from every single sapling planted.
* Formula: Tree Count * (Strength Multiplier / 10 )
## 2. Realistic Mode (Logarithmic)
In reality, noise absorption follows a diminishing returns curve. The first few trees do the most heavy lifting, and as the forest gets denser, each additional tree adds slightly less benefit.
* Formula: log_2(TreeCount + 1) * Strength Multiplier
# New Feature : Cell Bleedover Previously the map was divided up into cells in which pollution was calculated per cell; this is still the case but I have now added a new method that applies a bleedover from cell to cell to make it more smooth and realistic. The function for this is;
Weight = 1.0 - (Distance / (Radius Control + 1))
# How Does this Mod work? If you're curious to see, please see the GitHub Repo with the full source code.
# Planned Future Features * Species-specific noise absorption (fully customisable). * Age-specific noise absorption Currently added but limited to ignoring Dead or Young/ Sapling.(fully customisable). * Further performance and optimisation improvements.
# Support And Feedback
Thank you for downloading the mod! If you encounter any issues, please feel free to let me know in the forum thread.
